Revenue Operations Analyst

About the role
You'll partner with sales leadership on territory planning and quota setting, and keep our Salesforce data clean.

Qualifications
- 1-3 years of experience in sales operations or analytics.
- Strong SQL and Excel (VBA a plus); Tableau or Power BI.
- Bachelor's degree in business, economics or a related field.

Compensation
The base pay range for this role is $75,000 - $95,000 per year. We are an equal opportunity employer.
